category_title: Verbal students with HFA who struggle with environmental distractions and role ambiguity
minimal_context: The student and her partner are preparing to collaborate on a temple-building task in an OpenSim-based virtual environment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to start the temple-building task in the virtual environment. You and A need to work together on this.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am very excited to use the OpenSim environment! Where is A? We should walk or fly to the building area together.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: A is over on the other island right now. Go ahead and get started.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Takes the initiative to transport A to the gathering place) Okay, A is here now. We are ready to start our design work.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: A is asking who should lead the temple-building task. What do you want to tell A?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don ’t really know. I am gonna like what you gonna do.
